newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - March 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - March 24.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- A feature story on a model soldier in Nanjing city in east China's Jiangsu Province takes the headline of this leading newspaper in the country.
- People in major cities mark 100-day countdown to Hong Kong's return to the motherland on Sunday.
- Front-page editorial urges maintaining opening to the outside world as a basic state policy.
PEOPLE'S DAILY OVERSEAS EDITION
- Commentary says China made no payments to U.S. Democrats
FINANCIAL NEWS
- State Development Bank and Bank of China jointly loan 565 million yuan to Xiangfan Power Ltd in Hubei province
- Net assets of Shanghai International Trust and Investment Co reach 3.29 billion yuan an end 1996. Profits post average growth of 44 percent in five years
CHINA SECURITIES
- China light industry aims to create 100 powerful firms with annual sales of 2.0 billion yuan by 2000
- Xinhua Financial and Economic Information announces launch of satellite transmitted overseas financial data and information
CHINA BUSINESS DAILY
- China corn producing provinces struggle to save 10 million tonnes of grain from rotting
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- Editorial marks the 100-day countdown to Hong Kong's return to the motherland.
- Hu Jintao, member of Standing Committee of Politburo meets members of Hong Kong youth delegation attending celebrations of 100-day countdown to Hong Kong's return.
CHINA DAILY
- The All-China Student's Federation establishes fund in Beijing to encourage scientific and technical creativity of high school students.
